sources.title: Caprock README
sources.finding: Local desktop and daemon browser UI, agent tabs, existing subscriptions, phone pairing and CSV/JSONL exports.

sources.title: Security and data policy
sources.finding: Local cleartext session SQLite; selected integrations send data only when enabled. Worker permissions are bypassed, worktree is not a sandbox.

sources.title: Premium pricing
sources.finding: Free core; Premium $30 yearly or $100 once. Eight paid features include budget pause, Telegram replies, custom agents and additional accounts.

sources.title: Caprock for Teams
sources.finding: Customer-hosted aggregate usage service from $500/month billed yearly, not per person; prompts/code have no fields in its described uploaded schema.

sources.title: Task records
sources.finding: Markdown task IDs, body, assignee, budget and done criteria; state transition graph and append-only event calls.

sources.title: Task board
sources.finding: Create validates title and nonempty criteria, assigns unique ID and default $5 budget; mirrors task state to SQLite.

sources.title: Verification runner
sources.finding: Per-command five-minute cap; missing criteria/worktree escalates, failures bounce up to three rounds, outputs persist before Done.

sources.title: Verifier command screening
sources.finding: Destructive command regexes apply to done_criteria, not all agent commands.

sources.title: Orchestrator and worker router
sources.finding: Claude coordinator and worker processes, mailbox delivery, worker worktrees, bounded wakeups, budget kill and stop-all latch.

sources.title: Worktree ownership
sources.finding: Reuse owned path, refuse other checkout or preexisting branch; never force-reset it.

sources.title: Worktree setup
sources.finding: Copies configured ignored files and wraps initial agent command in setup; fresh worktree setup differs from reuse.

sources.title: MCP tool definitions
sources.finding: Read-only memories, prose, costs, sessions and CI tools; candidate search then full memory read.

sources.title: Message queue
sources.finding: 20 messages, 16 KiB each, only owned sessions; permission/question waits prevent unsafe prompt typing.

sources.title: Permission endpoint
sources.finding: Allow/always/deny/dismiss choice tied to prompt ID; delegates to live prompt validation.

sources.title: Paired device controller
sources.finding: Controller forbids arbitrary commands/flags, limits paths to resolved home, rechecks role for each input frame.

sources.title: Changes API
sources.finding: Status/diff/stage/discard/commit/push/pull interface; device mutations constrained to project/worktree scope.

sources.title: PR pipeline
sources.finding: PR stages, checks by exact head SHA, releases and linked session cost; display is not merge authorization.

sources.title: PTY lifecycle contract
sources.finding: Detached process can live in separate PTY host; pause is POSIX signal or Windows input hold, not identical execution suspension.

sources.title: Loop detector
sources.finding: Repeated tool signatures counted per main/subagent lane; default five calls in three minutes emits an alert.

sources.title: Offline entitlement
sources.finding: Expiry parsed locally with seven-day grace; no network validation.

sources.title: Desktop dependencies
sources.finding: Rust Tauri2 desktop wrapper around daemon dashboard.

sources.title: Caprock: cli-core
sources.finding: CLI starts and stops daemon, installs service/hooks, lists and creates board tasks over loopback API. It is not an SDK or a promise of stable automation for every UI operation.

sources.title: Caprock: api-routes
sources.locator: route registrations; task, agents, files, brain, GitHub, export
sources.finding: Public daemon routes distinguish board task create/get/approve/reject/verify from agent session controls, memory edits, file reads and GitHub operations; no task hierarchy, spec approval, artifact gallery or merge/deploy authority endpoint.

sources.title: Caprock: launch
sources.finding: Installed harness commands receive selected model, effort and native permission/resume flags; Codex/OpenCode fork is refused; OpenCode has provider/model syntax. This is local CLI integration, not a replacement model service.

sources.title: Caprock: ios
sources.finding: iOS bundles ui/dist-remote React screens in Capacitor, with native storage/biometric/scanner plugins; not a separate native agent runtime.

sources.title: Caprock for iPhone
sources.finding: Documents free iPhone App Store distribution, approved 2026-11-05, same phone remote UI. Store URL was inaccessible to the retrieval tool on this pass; distribution claim is first-party documentation.

sources.title: Caprock: platform-build
sources.finding: Desktop packages Tauri web UI for macOS, Windows and Linux; macOS minimum 13.0.

sources.title: Caprock: task-ui
sources.locator: GROUPS, TaskDrawer, Checks, WhereItIs, NewTask, StartOrchestrator
sources.finding: Board distinguishes waiting/working/checking/needs-you/done/failed, creates briefs with commands and budget, optional templates, explicit runner activation. Drawer links assigned session diff/worktree, lists verification rounds and copies manual merge command. Done without recorded checks is explicitly displayed.

sources.title: Caprock: mailbox
sources.finding: Task-linked assign/result/question/escalation Markdown mail has from/to/task IDs, atomic local writes and routing ledger; invalid paths quarantined. Sender strings and writable files are not authenticated human identities.

sources.title: Caprock: workboard
sources.finding: Read-only aggregate view combines existing local task/session/queue/cost/PR state, not an epic or dependency scheduler.

sources.title: Caprock: queueboard
sources.finding: Work queue shows owned live/recent sessions and estimates from project history; message queue is distinct from CPU/RAM admission.

sources.title: Caprock: instructions
sources.finding: Reads CLAUDE.md, .claude/CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md up to 64KiB, scoped to project roots; product project system prompt is separate. Harness consumes instructions.

sources.title: Caprock: brain
sources.finding: Optional idle-session extraction uses configured installed reader CLI, with rolling token/read budgets and failure backoff; not a provider-free background model.

sources.title: Caprock: brain-search
sources.finding: Search ranks stored memory text using normalized keywords/IDF and typo fallback; not whole-repository semantic indexing.

sources.title: Caprock: brain-edit
sources.finding: Memory nodes can be edited/deleted and linked/superseded with source records; imported notes must be changed/deleted in their source vault. No requirements approval/gating subsystem.

sources.title: Caprock: brain-scrub
sources.finding: Redacts stored memory and source excerpts transactionally; does not retroactively remove secrets from raw session transcripts.

sources.title: Caprock: obsidian
sources.finding: Explicit local Markdown vault import rescans changed files and unlinks deleted notes; bounded at 50000 notes and 4MiB per note.

sources.title: Caprock: mcp-register
sources.finding: Explicitly registers local caprock MCP server in Claude/Codex configurations through their CLIs; not a generic Caprock MCP client.

sources.title: Caprock: files
sources.finding: Project/worktree file listing and capped reads reject symlink/path escapes; current filesystem contents, no immutable artifact snapshots.

sources.title: Caprock: paste
sources.finding: Allowed image/PDF/text/office/source uploads up to 10MiB persist as local files with restricted names/modes for agent input; no general task artifact registry.

sources.title: Caprock: capture
sources.finding: Feedback capture produces a real own-window image on macOS/Windows; Linux capture button unsupported. Not automatic screenshots of tested products or video capture.

sources.title: Caprock: devshare
sources.finding: Explicit temporary proxy shares only loopback dev servers via private LAN/Tailscale access, opaque link/cookie, at most three shares, 30-minute idle/8-hour max, no restart persistence.

sources.title: Caprock: review-notes
sources.finding: Per-worktree line/range notes retain code quote and timestamp in browser localStorage until sent/cleared; no user identity or exact commit hash, and no shared review ledger.

sources.title: Caprock: changes-ui
sources.locator: sendNotes, key handlers, file/diff and conflict controls
sources.finding: Diff review supports line notes sent as one agent prompt, staging and keyboard navigation; notes are cleared after handoff. This is request-changes assistance, not revision-bound approval.

sources.title: Caprock: pulls
sources.finding: Creates GitHub PR after optional push; validates branch/base/remote and handles existing PR. Reads reviews/check status. No native approve/merge mutation in scoped routes.

sources.title: Caprock: ci
sources.locator: CI, CIRun.HeadSHA, jobs/log reads, refresh intervals
sources.finding: Reads CI runs/jobs/steps for commit SHA, retains bounded log tails and timestamps; list-rate runner estimates differ from invoices.

sources.title: Caprock: release-ci
sources.finding: Reads tag/release workflow status and release links using bounded recent-run search; does not authorize releases or deployments.

sources.title: Caprock: ci-retry
sources.finding: Opt-in rerun only when all failed jobs got no runner; eligible recent runs are recorded before API call, capped history 256 entries; ordinary failed tests are not automatically retried by this policy.

sources.title: Caprock: git-project
sources.finding: Scoped Git mutations use per-checkout locks, refusal checks and stale discard token; pull is fast-forward only. Divergence/conflicts require terminal/agent repair, not automatic rebase.

sources.title: Caprock: github-intake
sources.finding: User-triggered open GitHub issue/PR picker with body/URL seeds context; not background bidirectional issue synchronization.

sources.title: Caprock: host-registry
sources.finding: Separate PTY holders persist private atomic connection records and child-exit records for daemon reattachment.

sources.title: Caprock: host-client
sources.finding: Reattaches live holders, replays bounded output since offset, retries connection with bounded attempts, uses sequenced writes/acks; unreachable holder is lost process, not revived execution.

sources.title: Caprock: host-server
sources.finding: Holder deduplicates sequenced client writes in memory; no exactly-once guarantee for arbitrary agent tool effects or after holder death.

sources.title: Caprock: resume
sources.finding: Ended sessions require supported native resume ID and extant transcript/directory; live owned sessions reused. Stored display history does not guarantee native resumability.

sources.title: Caprock: interrupted
sources.finding: Durable heartbeat distinguishes interrupted local work after restart; does not automatically restore a dead operating-system process.

sources.title: Caprock: continue
sources.finding: Supported Claude account/provider continuation can copy/fork native transcript; cross-harness transfer is a separate brief flow.

sources.title: Caprock: handoff
sources.finding: Editable cross-harness brief takes latest assistant passage, changed files and known PR links, capped at 8000 characters; not full native context or permissions transfer.

sources.title: Caprock: reconnect-ui
sources.finding: Browser socket retries with jitter up to 15 seconds, wake probes and explicit disconnected/revoked states; implemented recovery policy, not observed success.

sources.title: Caprock: supervisor
sources.finding: Desktop reuses one compatible daemon per data directory; quitting viewer leaves daemon/agent sessions. Host must remain running.

sources.title: Caprock: queue-resend
sources.finding: Explicit resend finds live/resumable session in same agent/folder or creates fresh session; does not silently replay all previous tool actions.

sources.title: Caprock: resources
sources.finding: Measures local owned process CPU/RAM on demand for UI and orphan cleanup; no CPU/RAM reservation or resource admission queue.

sources.title: Caprock: daily-cap
sources.finding: Optional Premium daily API-equivalent budget pauses owned sessions only; external sessions untouched, estimates not provider billing controls.

sources.title: Caprock: window-cap
sources.locator: window sample freshness, pause latch, reset resume
sources.finding: Premium Claude window pause uses fresh plan samples and persisted state; respects manual resume and resumes after reset.

sources.title: Caprock: planshare
sources.finding: Allocates user-entered subscription fee over recorded list-price usage; incomplete usage and provider allowance remain distinct from invoices.

sources.title: Caprock: cost-refresh
sources.finding: Subscription spend projection caches a minute; not real-time billed reconciliation.

sources.title: Caprock: export
sources.finding: Offline read-only SQLite export of events/sessions as TSV/CSV/JSONL, optional raw JSONL payload; not a full task/runtime migration bundle.

sources.title: Caprock: pairing
sources.locator: roles, single-use code, device token lifecycle
sources.finding: Paired device viewer/controller permissions, expiring one-use pairing code and revocable device token; not organization member roles.

sources.title: Caprock: csrf
sources.finding: Loopback local-owner API enforces browser CSRF/origin and DNS-rebinding guards; not SSO authenticated organization access.

sources.title: Caprock: lan-auth
sources.finding: Paired requests require token and role-scoped routes; controller input and Git paths constrained. Local owner access is broader than device access.

sources.title: Caprock: remote-keys
sources.finding: Private daemon identity and optional persistent remote enablement stored locally, configurable relay URL.

sources.title: Caprock: relay-worker
sources.finding: Public Cloudflare Worker relay authenticates machine proof and forwards encrypted frames through in-memory sockets; source has no durable message storage, production infrastructure logs not audited.

sources.title: Caprock: relay-selfhost
sources.finding: Own Go relay implementation routes paired encrypted sockets, caps devices and expires silent hosts; not agent compute.

sources.title: Caprock: secrets
sources.finding: Product integration tokens use macOS Keychain or 0600-file fallback; this does not cover every provider credential or all config fields.

sources.title: Caprock: config
sources.finding: Local configuration includes retention-days default zero, opt-in update checks, Brain extraction selection, optional integrations and Gemini API key field. Defaults are not a vendor infrastructure audit.

sources.title: Caprock: cleanup
sources.finding: Idle cleanup removes old paste files, old logs/backup copies and eligible telemetry files; does not clear entire retained transcript database.

sources.title: Caprock: event-retention
sources.finding: Configured event pruning keeps session rows and materialized totals; does not mean all historical derivatives or source transcripts were deleted.

sources.title: Caprock: remove
sources.finding: Explicit local session removal deletes associated event/stat/index rows and records tombstone against reingestion; does not delete upstream native transcript or all independent memory/files.

sources.title: Caprock: logcap
sources.finding: Local daemon logs rotate at 64MiB with one retained generation and idle trimming; not immutable audit storage.

sources.title: Caprock: support-send
sources.finding: Feedback sends user-selected text/screenshots/email plus app version/OS after explicit request, not automatic session upload. Hosted support retention is a policy question.

sources.title: Caprock: sharecard
sources.locator: PNG share and local delete token
sources.finding: Explicit selected PNG share uploads rendered image; deletion token remains local. Share is separate from raw session export or artifact archive.

sources.title: Caprock: telegram
sources.locator: owner private chat, dispatch and entitlement checks
sources.finding: Optional bot tied to one owner private chat; Premium two-way replies/start/stop/approval use owned sessions, free alerts differ from coauthor collaboration.

sources.title: Caprock: chat-import
sources.finding: Local Claude.ai/ChatGPT export importer produces read-only chats, not live sync or import of an entire Caprock task/runtime database.

sources.title: Caprock terms
sources.finding: Terms dated 2026-10-07 state USD excluding jurisdictional taxes, personal key usable on own work machines, cancellation stops renewal, paid-period access remains, seven-day expiry grace, and free app/data remain available.

sources.title: Caprock licence
sources.finding: Root public repository is Apache-2.0; licence text is documentary evidence, not inspected implementation or proof of hosted service parity.

sources.title: Caprock: agent-binaries
sources.finding: Named launch list includes Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, Grok Build, Hermes and Cursor Agent. Custom agent commands are a separate Premium route.

sources.title: Caprock: grok-launch
sources.finding: Grok local CLI launch/resume/fork/model flags are implemented; comments explicitly distinguish terminal from absent Grok turn/cost ingestion.

sources.title: Caprock: cursor-launch
sources.finding: Cursor model/resume/force flags and session hook environment are implemented; without hooks terminal launch does not create full turn capture.

sources.title: Caprock independent inspection: review-queue
sources.finding: Turn/prompt waiting is Claude-hook-specific; non-Claude kinds return no waiting state. SendNow and automatic delivery delete the queue row before typing, so a typing failure is not lossless. Ended-session queues and explicit resend are separate recovery paths.

sources.title: Caprock independent inspection: review-idle
sources.finding: Default configured idle window is 12h; excludes open tabs, orchestrator workers, shells, paused/queued/pending-prompt or continuing background/subagent work. This ends eligible local processes, not a cloud sandbox TTL.

sources.title: Caprock independent inspection: review-windows-pause
sources.finding: Windows pause holds input without suspending the process. POSIX pause semantics cannot be attributed to Windows; task worker kill is a separate control.

sources.title: Caprock independent inspection: review-log-platform
sources.finding: logcap is supported on unix; non-unix path sets supported=false. Windows service logging is separate.
